item.tib: bla ma rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa las rgyud skong pad+ma dkar po mu tig 'phreng ba
item.coloph: ces pas bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam rgyud nas bskang ba/ rig 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas gling pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa rgya mtsho lta bu la/ phran gyis rgya mtsho'i nang nas 'khyor gang blangs nas gar bsgar bas/ ma 'ongs thos chung blo rmongs rnams la thig re phog pas skoms pa'i gdung ba sel phyir/ mi pham mgon po bdag gis brtsams pa'i 'gal 'khrul mchis na bla na ma mchis pa'i lha/ rigs bdag pad+ma thod phreng dang gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ dge mchis gang zag tsha gdung sel zhing bstan pa'i dpal rgyan du gyur cig/
